recipe.name: Brisket
directions: Start cooking the brisket eight hours before dinner.
Rub the meat the night before and pull it out of the refrigerator to warm to room temperature.
Set up the kettle for indirect heat with fresh charcoal intermixed with hot coals and a large drip pan in the middle.
Use a considerable amount of charcoal, both for the long cooking time and the cold.
Put the meat on the grate fat side down.
Baste the brisket every 30 minutes with its drippings and beer.
Add dry wood chips to an open but nearly stalled fire to quickly revive it.
After about seven hours on the grill, tightly wrap the brisket with foil and transfer it to a hot oven to finish.
Spread the remaining charcoal and coals in an even layer, add a cast iron pan full of oil, and work the potatoes.
After about an hour, transfer the brisket to a cutting board to rest.
Thinly slice the brisket against the grain.
